title: Team names
intro: These are the lists of team names used when teams get an automatic name (auto-register or reuse-cards). They are managed in the studio.
ownOnlyDesc: Draw names only from your custom lists. If you have no list for an age, the default lists are used instead.
saveError: Couldn't save the change. Check your connection and try again.
defaultListsSubtitle: The shared catalog of names available to everyone.
customListsSubtitle: Names added for your account in the studio.
customListsEmpty: You have no custom lists yet - the default lists are used.
